@deskSetAppearTheme.description: Settings › Appearance row: light or dark colours.

@deskSetAppearThemeHint.description: Hint under the Theme row. 'System' is the first choice (deskSetAppearSystem).

@deskSetAppearSystem.description: Theme choice: follow the computer's light or dark setting. One short word: a segment of a three-part switch.

@deskSetAppearDark.description: Theme choice: dark colours. One short word: a segment of a three-part switch.

@deskSetAppearLight.description: Theme choice: light colours. One short word: a segment of a three-part switch.

@deskSetAppearScale.description: Settings › Appearance row: make text and controls larger or smaller (90 % to 150 %).

deskSetAppearScaleHint: Text and controls, larger or smaller. Applies at once.

@deskSetAppearScaleHint.description: Hint under the Interface scale row.

@deskSetAppearLanguage.description: Settings › Appearance row: the language of the app. The language names in its list stay in their own language.

@deskSetAppearLanguageHint.description: Hint under the Language row: no restart needed.

deskSetAppearHideHint: Shows dots in place of balances and amounts.

@deskSetAppearHideHint.description: Hint under the Hide amounts row (the row's title is deskOvHideAmounts).
